root_cause.text: The dma-buf buffer object (bo) was attached to the exporter's attachment list before it was fully initialized, allowing the exporter's `invalidate_mappings` callback to race and access an incomplete or already-freed bo, leading to NULL pointer dereferences or use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states two races: (1) "We do xe_bo_alloc() followed by the attach, before the actual full bo init step... exporter driver can at any time call back into our invalidate_mappings hook, with an empty/bogus bo" and (2) "if xe_bo_init_locked() fails... the bo will be freed on error, but we still have it attached... so if the invalidate_mappings is now triggered then the bo we access is gone." The patch fixes the ordering by moving the `dma_buf_attach()` call to after `xe_dma_buf_init_obj()` completes, ensuring the bo is fully initialized before becoming visible to the exporter.
